name: Snowy Taggers
summary:
Snowy Taggers is a fan-made VR tag game inspired by the original Gorilla Tag, built for players who love fast-paced movement and fun in virtual snow-covered worlds. Using just your hands—no sticks, no buttons—you’ll run, jump, climb, and slide your way through a frozen map designed for chaotic and exciting tag battles.
